notes.title: Welcome to Mini Motor Racing EVO!
notes.content:
Hi everyone :)

Thanks for stopping by! We hope you enjoy your stay here and time with Mini Motor Racing EVO. We've put in countless hours of blood, sweat and tears to develop a game that we're proud to be bringing to Steam. 

Several members of the dev team will be hanging around the community groups in the coming days and weeks listening to feedback and bug reports so we can continue to make Mini Motor Racing EVO the best game it can be. 

In the event that there are any teething issues, rest assured that we'll be on the case and are keen to address issues as they arise. 

Thanks again for visiting and we sincerely hope you enjoy your trip down classic arcade racer lane! ;)

- The Binary Mill Team
